GREG, 2026-11-06 about 05:52Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #364, message ffd66ec3), answering Fable's A/B question. Verbatim: „B. Naprawdę wystarczy.”
AMENDED BY GREG, 2026-11-06 about 16:20Z (Asistant #390, message 2ec544e6), verbatim: „EO nie mialo tego uzywac, mialo sprawdzac tylko stan przed i PO wariant B ABY ... TO UPROSCIC”. So EO option B uses the existing source_id BEFORE and AFTER only. There is NO watcher-event condition for refusal, fencing or credit; remove any such dependency and don't delay EO for watcher work.
CURRENT OPTION B (TermAl w-24a72c898d6d):
(1) The host takes a rev 5 source_id capture at commit X BEFORE it dispatches the turn's prompt.
(2) The credited declared test is the turn's FIRST tool action; execution identity shows it originates from that turn.
(3) After the run, a clean rev 5 source_id capture at the same commit X.
(4) check.started_at is the host-observed first start reservation.
The former item "(4) the watcher can only disqualify" is REMOVED by Greg's 16:20Z word, and with it any .git/info comparison.
Accepted limit: a change made and fully reverted during the run (between the two captures) is not detected. Credited tests run as the first action of a fresh turn.
